final_report:
T62 live Playwright verification of http://192.168.1.57:8000/ - VERDICT: FAIL (3 concrete defects listed below; all other checks pass). No source files modified.

GLOBAL CHECKS (six pages x widths 640/768/1024/1280 = 24 combos each):
[FAIL] exactly one h1: / and /sage-library.html and /sage-sessions.html and /sage-settings.html and /sage-health.html all have exactly 1 h1 at every width. /sage-workspace.html has ZERO h1 elements at ALL four widths (confirmed in source: no <h1> anywhere in sage-workspace.html; page title lives in topbar span #session-title).
[FAIL] zero horizontal overflow (documentElement scrollWidth==clientWidth): all five other pages pass at all four widths. /sage-workspace.html OVERFLOWS at 640 (scrollWidth 1120 vs 640) and 768 (1248 vs 768); passes at 1024/1280. Root cause measured live: closed right rail keeps base rule .diagram-panel.closed{transform:translateX(100%)} inside the <=1023px layout where it becomes position:absolute (mobile override resets only margin-right), so the 480px painted panel extends the scrollable overflow region to viewport+480. Mitigation exists (body/html overflow-x:hidden so users cannot actually scroll horizontally) but the stated scrollWidth gate fails.
[PASS] zero uncaught console/page errors across all pages and ALL interactive flows: none. Only console entry ever seen: favicon.ico 404 on initial load - non-blocking per task brief.
[PASS] topbar + Navigate sidebar present everywhere: .topbar, #menu-btn, #sidebar and all six nav links (index.html, sage-workspace.html, sage-library.html, sage-sessions.html, sage-settings.html, sage-health.html) found on all six pages at all four widths.
[FAIL] Escape closes mobile sidebar backdrop: home, workspace, library, settings, health PASS (sidebar collapsed -> open -> collapsed, backdrop class toggles, aria-expanded flips on home/workspace). /sage-sessions.html FAILS: clicking #menu-btn opens fine but Escape does NOTHING - close_sidebar() is defined (sage-sessions.html line ~144) but no keydown/Escape listener is bound anywhere on that page (library has one at line 259; sessions does not).

INTERACTIVE/LIVE CHECKS:
1 [PASS] HOME chat: typed 'teach me recursion' -> Send -> POST /api/sessions fired and session auto-created (id 8f3d8c49c254410d8314e2dd739cb3b9, also appears in sidebar); typing indicator appeared at +39ms; assistant bubble streamed and grew (109 chars mid-stream -> 640 final); done at +3.75s; URL unchanged throughout (no redirect for plain chat).
2 [PASS] WORKSPACE continuity + mermaid tool flow (?session=8f3d8c49...): history replayed prior user+assistant messages before sending ('Mastering the Art of Recursion'). Sent 'Now show me that as a mermaid diagram.' -> composer status text changed during tool phases exactly as specified (SSE tool_call sets 'generating mermaid...' during the turn, cleared on tool_result, then 'generating mermaid...' again from requestArtifact post-done); artifact rendered BOTH routes: composer Diagram button -> POST /sessions/{id}/outputs returned 200 validated envelope in 20.3s (attempts:2), right panel AUTO-OPENED with svg rendered + diagram_type caption 'flowchart-v2' + badge 'validated', artifacts-count 0->1; chat-send path -> illustrated card under the assistant message ('Sage illustrated this') with rendered mermaid <svg> at +35.6s. Both well under the 90s budget; no ENV-TIMEOUT needed. Probe note: two early runs each persisted a duplicate turn pair because attempt #1's browser died AFTER dispatching the send (server messages at 03:01:19 and 03:03:22 are identical pairs from my two probes, not a UI bug - UI dedupes via client_msg_id only per message, my runs sent twice intentionally-by-accident).
3 [PASS] WORKSPACE quiz/todo routing: Quiz button generated a 5-question card routed to LEFT #plan-artifacts rail (not diagramBody), badge 'validated', Plan section auto-opened (aria-expanded true); Todo button likewise (left rail, validated, 3 items). Todo item click flipped data-done false->true AND aria-pressed true AND persisted localStorage key sage_artifact_todo_<output_id>. Quiz select+reveal works per design: option click marks .selected, then 'Reveal answer' button reveals (card gains .revealed, picked option 'selected incorrect', correct option 'reveal-correct', explanation shown e.g. 'Not quite. The base case is...', button becomes disabled 'Answer revealed').
4 [PASS] done.actions chips: after sending 'Teach me one small step about recursion base cases.', done rendered TWO action chips ('Move to recursive steps', 'See a base case example'); clicking the first sent its full prompt as a NEW user message (user msg count 7->8, new bubble starts 'Now that we know why we need to stop, let's look at the recursive step...'). Model-dependent feature present and functional.
5 [PASS] Stop button: started 'Explain recursion in detail with many examples.', clicked stop mid-stream at bubble length 103; stream aborted (length stabilized at 113 including ~10 chars of in-flight buffer, ZERO further growth across 3s of samples), stop button hidden again, composer-error stayed hidden, no 'Connection error' bubble, and fire-and-forget POST /api/sessions/{id}/stop observed on the wire.
6 [PASS] MathJax: after a prompt requesting $$ display math, 118 mjx-container elements rendered across 3 assistant bubbles. Residual raw '$$' text appears only inside code fences, which the MathJax config deliberately skips (skipHtmlTags includes code/pre) - correct behavior.
7 [PASS] LIBRARY: initial rows loaded (GET /api/files). Uploaded temp t62_probe_<stamp>.md via hidden #file-input setInputFiles -> row appeared with foam pill 'ready' and 16 chunks. Clicking the ready row opened excerpts modal; Fetch with chunk id '<file_id>:0:0' (format verified against app/services/chunking.py) rendered location caption (section ... ; lines 3-3), excerpt text and 'after' context block; Escape closed the modal. Delete button + accepted confirm() removed the row (rowGone true). Also cleaned up a stale probe file left by my own earlier crashed run (destructive ops confined to probe-created resources).
8 [PASS] SESSIONS: cards rendered including the probe session ('Mastering the Art of Recursion'). New Session modal opened, goal 'playwright probe' submitted -> card appeared (id 5e77e8ae2b394b73af0b156e6c303275, count 2->3). Deleted ONLY that probe session (confirm accepted); count back to 2 and no 'playwright probe' card remains; pre-existing sessions untouched.
9 [PASS] SETTINGS: selects populated from GET /api/preferences (depth brief, pacing slow, style analogy-first). Changed depth to standard -> Save -> button feedback 'Saved ✓' AND server PATCH confirmed via re-fetch (persistedAfterSave1 true). Reverted depth back to brief -> Save -> 'Saved ✓' again and server confirmed revert. PATCH /api/preferences seen on the wire both times.
10 [PASS] HEALTH: overall icon 'health_icon ok' (foam) + status badge ok; Model Configured dot ok 'Yes'; Endpoint Reachable dot ok 'Yes'; Refresh button fired a fresh GET /api/health and re-rendered with updated Checked At timestamp.

CONSOLE ERRORS LIST (entire session): exactly one - favicon.ico 404 on first load (explicitly non-blocking per task). Zero pageerrors. Zero HTTP >=400 besides that favicon.

SCREENSHOTS (.agents/jobs/evidence/): t62_home_1280.png, t62_home_640.png, t62_workspace_1280.png (illustrated-card state), t62_workspace_640.png, t62_library_1280.png (uploaded row ready), t62_library_640.png.

DEFECTS FOR FIX (all static-side, likely follow-up task for Turing):
D1 sage-workspace.html has NO h1 element (accessibility/structure; add visually-styled h1 or promote existing title).
D2 sage-workspace.html horizontal overflow at 640/768: mobile @media(max-width:1023px) override for .diagram-panel.closed must also neutralize transform:translateX(100%) (or clip within positioned parent) - currently only margin-right is reset.
D3 sage-sessions.html missing document keydown Escape handler (modal-first-then-sidebar like library line 259); sidebar/backdrop cannot be closed with keyboard.

VERDICT: FAIL pending D1-D3. Everything else about the redesign verified working live end-to-end.
